plan.message:
Decode payload first. Split on ASCII spaces retaining empty fields; use consecutive groups of 128 fields, last shorter if needed. A field's weight is its Unicode code-point length minus 5. For each group sum its weights. Repeatedly remove the LEFT field if sum>0, otherwise the RIGHT field, subtract its weight, and save it. Reverse the saved fields. Join all groups with ASCII spaces, preserve every other character; print only.
